purpose: Higher-order thinking as practice for optional deep-confirm open probes. Used by prose extractor only — not sent verbatim to Jev.

scale.label: Absent
scale.signal: Assertion only; no why, tradeoff, or stop-rule.

scale.label: Recall
scale.signal: Names a tool or step; judgment evaporates after the sentence.

scale.label: Apply
scale.signal: Concrete situation plus what they did; little on failure modes or write-back.

scale.label: AnalyzeEvaluate
scale.signal: Tradeoffs, stop-rule, provenance (how they would know they were wrong); judgment applied then lost.

scale.label: CreateCompound
scale.signal: Designs a loop: capture → verify → write back to memory they own; next practice named.

aggregate.rule: Use the weaker of the two probe scores toward soft level check.

soft_check.signal: challenge claimed_level down in Jev context
L4–L5 only if staircase already agrees

extract_thin.when_true: Force judgment_ready soft path; local save only
